maldives/02.creator: Simon Infanger
maldives/02.title: A graceful white egret stalks its prey through the crystal-clear shallows of the Red Sea coast. Under a blazing midday sun, the bird’s pristine plumage stands out against the shimmering turquoise water and the golden ripples of the sandy seabed. In the distance, a quiet sandbar separates the shallow lagoon from the deep blue horizon. This image captures a moment of focused intensity in nature, where the stillness of the water meets the sharp precision of a hunter. The atmosphere is one of serene isolation and tropical warmth, highlighting the raw beauty of the coastal ecosystem.
